description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). A read: the site's writing rules and the social rules on a LinkedIn post's text (the AI tells, the slop, claims, announcement openers, engagement bait, hashtags), its length, what shows before "see more", and, with post, whether it links the post. Rewrite each finding and lint again until ready. Posts nothing.

post.description: The published post it shares (its URL or slug): the text is checked for its link

text.description: The LinkedIn post's text, as the engineer would post it (at most 10000 characters)

name: lint_social

ready.description: No finding from the lint. Client confidentiality is still the engineer's to check: no client or client result the article doesn't state

title: Lint a LinkedIn post
